import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

repo = Path.cwd()
task = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/transition-prefix-boundary-20261007'
prior = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/action-transition-opportunity-20261007/transition-observation'
runs = []
for scene in ('dev-08-regent-boss', 'dev-09-necrobinder-boss', 'dev-06-silent-boss'):
    previous_command = json.loads((prior / scene / 'command.json').read_text())
    command = list(previous_command['command'])
    out = task / 'prefix-observation-gated' / scene
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    command[1] = str(task / 'harness-prefix-gated/OfflineSearchHarness.dll')
    command[command.index('--out') + 1] = str(out)
    command[command.index('--label') + 1] = 'transition-prefix-' + scene
    environment = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
                   if not k.startswith(('OFFLINE_HARNESS_', 'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY', 'DOTNET_PerfMap'))}
    environment['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(repo / '.local/tool-tasks/open-potion-primary-proof-20261007/build-candidate-v4/CombatSolver.dll')
    environment['OFFLINE_HARNESS_TRANSITION_PROBE'] = '1'
    environment['OFFLINE_HARNESS_TRANSITION_PREFIX_PROBE'] = '1'
    (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps({**previous_command, 'command': command,
        'sourceBase': 'a9f6b558', 'probe': 'History prefix identity census',
        'environmentOverrides': {k: v for k, v in environment.items() if k.startswith('OFFLINE_HARNESS_')}
    }, indent=2) + '\n')
    started = time.monotonic()
    with (out / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
        completed = subprocess.run(command, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                   timeout=previous_command['outerTimeoutSeconds'])
    result = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
    harness = json.loads((out / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
    control = json.loads((prior / scene / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
    observations = json.loads((out / 'action-transition-probe.json').read_text())
    comparison = {k: harness[k] == control[k]
                  for k in ('comparisonQuality', 'root', 'searchPolicy', 'budget', 'solverMetrics', 'pruneCounters')}
    # Solver elapsed/GC attribution is diagnostic and varies. Quality and semantic
    # work counters remain separately archived rather than compared as one value.
    run = dict(scene=scene, exitCode=completed.returncode, status=result['status'],
               launcherWallSeconds=time.monotonic() - started, controlMatch=comparison,
               observations=observations, command=json.loads((out / 'command.json').read_text()),
               harnessResult=harness, result=result)
    runs.append(run)
    (task / 'prefix-observation-gated-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(scene=scene, status=result['status'], controlMatch=comparison,
        completed=observations['Completed'], repeats=observations['Repeats'],
        prefixRepeats=observations['PrefixRepeats'], prefixMatches=observations['PrefixSelectedMatches'],
        prefixBeforeMismatches=observations['PrefixBeforeMismatches'],
        prefixAfterMismatches=observations['PrefixAfterMismatches'],
        prefixLimitBypasses=observations['PrefixLimitBypasses']), ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    if completed.returncode != 0 or not all(comparison[k] for k in
        ('comparisonQuality', 'root', 'searchPolicy', 'budget')):
        raise RuntimeError('Diagnostic semantic input or quality changed; inspect retained run.')

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

repo = Path.cwd()
task = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/transition-prefix-boundary-20261007'
name = 'transition-prefix-boundary-research-20261007'
older = json.loads((repo / 'docs/performance/action-transition-opportunity-20261007.json').read_text())
def compact_runs(path):
    compact = []
    for run in json.loads(path.read_text()):
        h = run['harnessResult']
        control = json.loads((repo / '.local/tool-tasks/action-transition-opportunity-20261007/transition-observation'
                             / run['scene'] / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
        label_diffs = [{k: [sample['priorLabel'][k], sample['currentLabel'][k]]
                        for k in sample['priorLabel']
                        if sample['priorLabel'][k] != sample['currentLabel'][k]}
                       for sample in run['observations']['Examples']]
        compact.append({k: run[k] for k in ('scene', 'exitCode', 'status', 'launcherWallSeconds', 'controlMatch',
                                          'command', 'observations')} | {
            'diagnosticOnly': True, 'comparisonQuality': h['comparisonQuality'],
            'budget': h['budget'], 'policy': h['searchPolicy'], 'solverMetrics': h['solverMetrics'],
            'pruneCounters': h['pruneCounters'], 'wallSeconds': h['wallSeconds'],
            'peakProcessWorkingSetBytes': h['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'],
            'timeBoundaryObserved': h['timeBoundaryObserved'],
            'savedLabelDifferences': label_diffs,
            'controlPruneDifferences': {k: [control['pruneCounters'].get(k), h['pruneCounters'].get(k)]
                for k in h['pruneCounters'] if control['pruneCounters'].get(k) != h['pruneCounters'].get(k)},
            'rootStampSha256': hashlib.sha256(run['result']['rootContinuationStamp'].encode()).hexdigest(),
        })
    return compact

gated = compact_runs(task / 'prefix-observation-gated-summary.json')
